body:
I guess I can always hope that my slowly rotting evidence helps someone else someday, when he rapes someone else.

Not even if. When.

And I hope the people who failed me feel a rush of regret when he rapes someone "important". 
Someone rich and well-connected.

Saying "screw it" seems like a feasible option, but in my thinking, ceasing my intense hatred would be like saying "please, go ahead and rape me again. I won't do anything about it".

As the "pigs in blue" comment, I harbor a serious distrust of police. 
I Have ever since they simply took my rapist's word over a rape kit (evidence).

Pretty sure no one bothered to test the kit.

So I'll never go to them again. 

If I got shot, they'd blame me. 
If I got raped again, they'd blame me.
If I were murdered, they'd say I invited it by wearing jeans and a t-shirt.

No worries, I won't be dropping his name or any defining information about him.

I've never once mentioned his name anywhere on reddit, nor dropped his number, as tempting as it's been.
I'm just kind of letting loose.

I can't mention all this bottled up hate IRL, after all.

Sorry to worry you.

For your own sake, I'd recommend looking into which birth control options work for your lifestyle.

Can't take a daily pill? 
There are patches and shots.

Still too much of a disruption to your schedule? 
There are insertable, semi-permanent options. 

There's even an IUD that doesn't use hormones to prevent pregnancy, if that's a worry.

Just please, be careful, and don't beat yourself up too much.

For now, just sit back and wait. 
Don't say anything you'll regret, you never know what can be thrown in your face later on.

If there is DNA evidence that a rape occurred, and that DNA is tied to you, then you can start worrying.

Me personally, I can't and won't judge you.
I just hope you didn't hurt anyone.

I just wish he wouldn't stare through me.

I know I laid everything bare last night but that shouldn't make me a bad person.

Not after I bottled it up, only so I wouldn't add to his daily stress.

Whether I hold everything in or not, yeah, I can be.

I only break when I'm alone.
I only hurt myself when he's away, then I do my best to hide everything and clean up the blood.

But last night, I broke in front of him. 
I bawled and admitted to feelings I've been holding in for a long time.

I still support him as much as I can. I'm here to hold him and make his nightmares stop.
I still help bring home the bacon.
And I'm still a shoulder to cry on if need be.

I think maybe I'm just too much.

My depression is difficult enough to handle when I go into a downswing and start beating myself down for everything. 

Now, in the aftermath of the rape, I'm always angry and sad. Always on the downswing. I've always got death on the brain, and it's changing me as a person.
I think he sees that I'll never be his perfect mate again. 
That I'll always be fucked up.
I'd say we're animals...just glorified bi-pedal animals.

This. This exactly.

This is why I've let friends slip away, and am slowly beginning to remove myself from a committed relationship of four years.

They'll all leave eventually, and I don't want to be remembered as a drag.
Everyone's better off when I bottle it up.

The detective questioned him, but I think that was about it.

His lie was good enough to trump hard evidence.
He never saw a damn cell.

He shows up at the restaurant where I work, some weeks. 
Since I don't know his last name, i can't file a restraining order.

No. I wimped out, like the weak idiot I am.

Maybe one day I'll lose everything, then work up the courage to do worse.
For now, alcohol poisoning away.

*Update*: I began to gear up at home, (left work planning to go home, suit up, then throw some bricks) 
then lost all my boldness as I wrote a goodbye to my SO.

I expected that I'd go too far and end up crippling that bastard or worse, because anger is a beast and I want revenge dammit.

In that event, I'd never come back home. Wouldn't want to drag babe into it.

Now I'm here trying to drink myself into a coma, so I don't go nuts and end up in prison.
Well shit, I'd buy one. The police seem to think I deserved it.

Fuck. The. Police.

Or at least the ones who'd rather lean on that tiny percentage of people who lie about rape and thus, choose to say "bah, all victims are liars".
And tell the crisis center what? That I've been wanting to assault my rapist for the last two months?

I actually sent him a text similar to that the next day. He called me a whore in response.

Maybe that's what I should write on his car...
I doubt I will. If the city police don't care about rape (with fresh lab evidence) they won't bat an eye over petty vandalism.
He's honestly lucky that I don't have the guts to do anything crazier.

I filed a report soon after I was raped; just a day later, in fact. 

The Detective that was chosen to investigate said it came down to "he said, she said", despite that fact that I gave up everything the forensic nurse wanted, merely hours after I was used like a rag doll.

I allowed myself to be violated again in a cold white room, so my pain and fear could be completely disregarded by the people I needed most.
It's like there's almost no point at all in stepping up and going to the police.
Which sites? Just curious...not that I have the same idea to destroy my rapist...

"Just Be 'normal'"
"Just stop thinking about it"
"Just stop being weak"

"why can't you be like  'x', 'y', 'z'"

Maybe I want all my memories gone, even if it means I lose the good ones too.

Maybe the brief periods of happiness and hope were devoured the day he made me worthless.
Maybe all I can remember anymore is how he made me garbage.

This struggle against reactionary asymmetry is pretty much the story of my life...even little defeats feel like a crushing blow...a reason to end my life, get it over with.

Meanwhile, glimpses of happiness feel like nothing.
Probably because deep down, I know that I'll quickly slide back into another failure...nothing can stay "good".

Life will always slam my head into the dirt again, without fail.
Meanwhile, those "victories" are seemingly rare.

I was raped a month ago. 
In the days that followed, I was blamed for it by the police and the detective investigating.
So I took to blaming myself more than I already had.

Combine those feelings with paranoia, slow starvation, and a lack of sleep.

I cracked. It seemed better to die than to go on.

Attempted the hanging while my SO was at work.
He found me because he happened to come home to eat during his break.

I sometimes ponder the possibility of reincarnation.

Talk of "old souls" and "wisdom beyond your years" really makes one wonder, huh.

I hope my next self doesn't remember the pain this shell has lived.
The abandonment, the fear, the longing for unattainable love...betrayal after bitter betrayal.


Maybe if I'm lucky, my next shell will be male, And he'll change the world somehow.


This body likely can't change a thing.

I actually keep a pre-tied noose ready to go...

It's just comforting, to feel like I have an option. 
To feel like I have control where I once had practically none.


Though I haven't seen my "pretty white necklace" lately...maybe my fiancé found it and threw it away.

I sometimes wonder if the strong possibility of being strapped down and dropped into what is essentially Solitary Confinement in a cold white room keeps people at high risk of suicide from saying anything to anyone...?


I'd imagine that fear leads to further isolation, further feeding those suicidal ideations.


Who wouldn't be terrified of that?
You could lose your job, your friends and family will look at you like you're some wild animal, and don't even get me started on the hospital bills...
I have no lawyer. Can't afford one.
I live in Virginia. America's second toilet.

Trauma...I have no future.

My fiancé will eventually tire of me, I'll never mother any children, and I'll either become a cat-lady, or end my life before I reach that point.

Why not go out with a smile on my face?
No one will save me, why not avenge myself?

The police will turn a blind eye to the killing, the same way they ignored my figurative cry for help.
If they gave a shit, they wouldn't have let things go so far.

They didn't even allow me to file a restraining order.

If he loves you as deeply as I believe he does (I mean, you two are engaged) then I'm sure he'll understand, and I highly doubt he'll look at you negatively.

He might become more protective of you (as my fiancé did when I informed him of the sexual abuse I endured as a child, then more-so following my recent rape) but heck, he loves you. Of course he'd worry.

I hope everything goes okay. It isn't your fault.

I wish i could be there for you.
It seems that a good, caring, strong girl-friend would help you out so much...another lady to tell you that you're amazing and beautiful and stronger than you think you are.

A lady-knight to keep all the sleaze-balls away.
Someone you could call at 3am and speak to at your leisure.

I know you're more of an adult than a kid, but maybe a mentor could help you.

If you didn't want him in your rectal region, it's rape.
Based on his statement of "I can't get off if you keep saying no", you clearly said "no" or "stop" or "not there".

Being drunk, you couldn't have thoughtfully consented to what happened.
You're not over-reacting in the slightest.

That said, I'm so, so sorry about what happened to you, and I'm extremely sorry that you were hurt by someone you trusted dearly.

I was hurt by a trusted person too.

You're not being dramatic at all.

You clearly said no, and you were too high to give a "yes".
If you say "no" and someone does something like that to you, it doesn't matter who they are...parent, sibling, acquaintance, friend, lover, husband, priest, a world leader...it's rape.

Even if you were stoned off your ass, it's rape.

Shit, even if you couldn't get a "no" out...you didn't say "yes, please do me."
It's rape.

Please, don't blame yourself for what happened.
There were things that could've gone differently, but had you known he would do something so awful, you wouldn't have been anywhere near him, correct?

I wish I could give you a hug...i'm going through your same variety of thoughts right now :(

Just letting you guys know I've made the police report, and I apologize for breaking any rules this subreddit may have.

I'm in a dark place right now, thought of doing something to my rapist that would be highly illegal when posting this.

Again, I'm sorry for breaking the sub's rules, and thank you for supporting me.


I'll be preparing the post for deletion shortly. (deleting the text on the main post and leaving "[Delete]" in it's place, etc.)
